svg.text: a domain model written in the calculus
its boundaries declared, audited, and decided by the build

text.tspan: ■ every number's kind is derived, checked, or attested
with a reason — or the build fails

svg.text: a quantity carries its kind in its type — what the number is a value of

text.tspan: ■ each module declares its inputs → outputs, with kinds
■ the build proves the code has exactly those
■ modules compose by contract, across repositories
PhysLib ■ dimensions checked at compile time:
a dimensionally wrong formula does not build
CSLib ■ the kind-transporting weak bisimulation is one
in the textbook sense — not a local re-definition

svg.text: tensors, CPU and GPU execution · the executable float word, specified

text.tspan: ■ one source, three carriers: ℝ to prove, FP32 to bound
rounding, IEEE32Exec to run — bridged by refinement theorems
definitions: community peer review before merge

svg.text: the Lean kernel + three classical axioms
the only thing that must be believed

text.tspan: ■ the build prints the axiom profile
small enough to re-implement — two dozen independent
checkers compete to reject bad proofs (Kernel Arena)
